text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of ADDYI may cause an increase in the incidence or severity of any of the reported adverse reactions [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3, 5.4) and Adverse Reactions (6.1) ]. In the event of overdosage, treatment should address the symptoms and supportive measures, as needed. There is no known specific antidote for flibanserin.
